set.body: Purpose: establish the non-self-referential source commit that the scientific validation artifact can truthfully name. Acceptance criteria: obtain explicit user publication authority; regenerate and inspect the 95-path source manifest; require its sorted path-list SHA-256 to equal 19b64ea00f616c663326a65a443f958a27e59ff1f4b9808d0775c7995ed3026c unless reviewed changes explain a new digest; exclude .mote, generated target output, validation/eyes4s-validation-0.1.0.json, and laws/.jvm/src/test/scala/eyes4s/laws/ScientificValidationFilesSuite.scala; include the fail-closed GenerateScientificValidationArtifact writer, its five-case court, and its documented command; stage only manifest paths, including deletion of obsolete generated ci.yml; inspect the staged diff; rerun the exact local CI gates; commit without amending unrelated history; push non-force through the canardlapin repository identity; prove local HEAD, tracking ref, and live remote SHA equality; record the exact hosted Checks run URL and job outcomes. Security is recorded separately and a failure there does not falsify code checks. Do not claim the trust milestone from this source commit because the clean validation artifact is necessarily subsequent.
